name: Spadamon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 1 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon that's level 3 or has the [Legend-Arms] trait, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [Legend-Arms] trait in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
